description: Tech job listings from Dice (US) for a keyword and optional location: title, company, location, how long ago it was posted, employment type (full-time, contract...), salary text as posted, and job URL, about 20 per page, plus the total number of matching jobs. Optional remote-only filter. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: Optional city or state, e.g. Austin, TX
